'''Jerry Darcy''' is a game designer credited as a designer of Decipher's ''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game (SWCCG).<ref name="wp-swccg">[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game Star Wars Customizable Card Game], Wikipedia (designer credit line)</ref>

== SWCCG role ==

Wikipedia lists Darcy among SWCCG's designers with [[Tom Braunlich]], [[Rollie Tesh]], and [[Warren Holland]].<ref name="wp-swccg" /> Some secondary game databases list Braunlich, Tesh, and Darcy as designers while omitting Holland; this wiki notes that conflict and still follows Wikipedia's four-name designer line on [[Creators of SWCCG]].<ref name="wp-swccg" /><ref name="cgdb">[https://cardgamedatabase.fandom.com/wiki/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game Star Wars Customizable Card Game], Card Game Database fandom wiki (designer field; secondary)</ref>

Decipher's contemporary Radio Free Decipher series described Darcy as Star Wars CCG '''Lead Game Designer''' in a December 1998 episode index entry.<ref name="rfd">[https://wiki.lotrtcgpc.net/wiki/Radio_Free_Decipher Radio Free Decipher episode index], LOTR-TCG PC wiki (episode 2 description)</ref> KendallCast community interviews (2020s) likewise introduce him as former Decipher Lead Designer for SWCCG and discuss early expansions including Premiere, ''A New Hope'', Hoth, Dagobah, and Special Edition.<ref name="kendall">[https://www.kendallcast.ninja/2021/05/jerry-darcy-on-premiere-new-hope-and.html KendallCast: Jerry Darcy on Premiere, A New Hope, and Hoth], 3 May 2021</ref><ref name="kendall2">[https://www.kendallcast.ninja/2021/11/jerry-darcy-on-dagobah.html KendallCast: Jerry Darcy on Dagobah], 2 November 2021</ref><ref name="kendall3">[https://www.kendallcast.ninja/2022/10/corran-on-horn-13-jerry-darcy-on.html KendallCast: Jerry Darcy on Special Edition], 10 October 2022</ref>

Those interview labels support a lead-design role during Decipher's expansion era. They do '''not''', by themselves, prove the exact start date of an official "Lead Designer" title relative to Premiere (December 1995).

The GeoCities anagram table maps [[Rayc Ryjerd]] and [[Rycar Ryjerd]] (extra R) to Jerry Darcy, [[Djas Puhr]] to Jasper (Jerry's cat), and [[Laudica]] to [[Claudia Darcy]].<ref name="ana">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/anagrams.html Anagramed Decipherians]</ref>
